label: Ephemeral bucket
type: the memory-only bucket type: no data is written to disk, so it supports neither disk persistence nor the persistence-based durability levels. The other of the two 8.0 bucket types.
note:
Promoted with bucket:couchbase-bucket as a closed two-member set - see that record for the memcached-removal story. Its constraint is the more interesting half: because nothing is persisted, durability:level-persist-to-majority is not available to it, which is a real product-level exclusion rather than a documentation gap.
